specification.design: Exploratory replay on previously collected snapshots; not prospective strategy validation
specification.sampling: Earliest usable 14-18 minute frozen-cohort change in each UTC quarter-hour
directions: sign of aggregate BTC base change
aggregate direction only if every single-account removal preserves it
specification.zero_breadth: Abstain; do not count flat predictions as zero-return successes
